description: This Java class 'AverageData' provides functionality to compute averaged XY data over specified divisions. It operates on XYData objects to generate smoothed data points, useful for data analysis or visualization within the 'com.rusefi.models' package.

classes.name: AverageData
classes.description: Utility class for calculating averaged versions of XYData datasets.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the average XYData over divided segments of the input data, returning a new XYData object with computed points.
